{{Quote|Task Force Starfall, this is Starfall leader. Prepare to attack. I repeat, prepare to attack.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Torrie]]|<ref name="Starfall">[[Starfall (adventure)|''Starfall'']]</ref>}}
'''Task Force Starfall''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Task force/Legends|task force]] that [[Attack on the Subjugator|attacked]] the [[Subjugator (Victory-class)|''Subjugator'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

Task Force Starfall consisted of one [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]], and four [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]].

[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Torrie]] acted as 'Starfall Leader' during the operation.
